description: Cameco mines and mills uranium in Canada and Kazakhstan. It also sells nuclear fuel services to utilities that run reactors.
NexGen Energy is developing a uranium mine in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan. It has no production yet.
The company explores for and produces uranium by in-situ recovery in Texas and Wyoming. It holds a physical uranium inventory.
Centrus Energy enriches uranium and supplies low-enriched uranium fuel to nuclear power plants.
The fund tracks an index of companies involved in uranium mining and the production of nuclear components.
Newmont mines gold, and some copper and silver, at operations in the Americas, Africa and Australia.
Agnico Eagle operates gold mines in Canada, Finland, Australia and Mexico.
The fund tracks an index of companies that mine gold and silver.
Intuitive Surgical makes robotic systems for minimally invasive surgery, with the instruments and accessories they use.
Stryker sells orthopaedic implants, surgical equipment and a robotic arm for joint replacement.
ExxonMobil explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas, and refines and sells petroleum products and chemicals.
